data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-h-w', meaning 'to delight'. In Islamic context, Midha symbolizes the pleasure and joy that comes from following the divine will. The name Midha carries the meaning “Delightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Midha usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a name that evokes feelings of happiness and positivity in those who bear it or encounter it. In Arabic literature, it is used to describe characters who embody these qualities, inspiring warmth, smiles, and goodwill in those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Midha is a reminder of the inner joy and peace that comes from a deep connection with Allah. Living a life in accordance with Allah's divine will not only brings worldly pleasures but also yields eternal happiness in the Hereafter. The name Midha encourages one to seek this delight through obedience to Allah and adherence to His commands and teachings in the Quran and Sunnah. Thus, bearing this name can serve as a daily inspiration for followers to stay on the path of righteousness and find joy and contentment in the service of Allah.
